versos.e: 3. Son of Hamor; seduces Jacob’ s daughter; killed by Jacob’ s sons Ge 33:19; 34; Jos 24:32; Jud 9:28
.The flocks and herds of Jacob kept in Ge 37:12-14
2. Also called SYCHAR, a city of refuge in Mount Ephraim Jos 20:7; 21:21; Jud 21:19
.Joshua assembled the tribes of Israel at, with all their elders, chiefs, and judges, and presented them before the Lord Jos 24:1-28
4. Ancestor of the Shechemites Nu 26:31; Jos 17:2
